signals.thesis: Caterpillar closed at $897.63 (+4.8%) near its 52-week high ($946.83). The construction and mining equipment giant benefits from the US infrastructure spending cycle and global re-industrialization theme. RSI 52.4 is ideal — strong momentum without overextension. ATR 39.2 implies natural price swings, so the $45 stop width (5%) is appropriate at 1.15x ATR. The industrial sector led broader market gains (+5% XLI) as the risk appetite snapback from yesterday's RISK-OFF selloff drove rotation into cyclicals.

Johnson & Johnson at $238.33 continues its secular uptrend, trading above both EMA20 ($231) and EMA50 ($230.91). RSI 63.2 confirms momentum without overextension. JNJ is a classic defensive play in EARLY RISK-OFF — healthcare staple with 3.2% dividend yield and uncorrelated returns vs cyclicals (correlation -0.04 with LRCX). The $9 stop (3.8%) is 1.9x ATR ($4.63), giving adequate room while respecting the 8% maximum. 52-week high at $251.71 provides the upside target.
